paragraphs.zh: 1967年，塔维斯托克的弗雷德·埃默里在《人际关系》期刊上发表了一篇题为《未来三十年》的论文。他指出，现代社会正步入他所称的“动荡场域环境”，即条件极其复杂且瞬息万变，以至于家庭、教会等传统社会稳定器开始瓦解。他表示，大众将通过变得被动来适应这一状况，而三种反应将催生这种被动性。

paragraphs.en: Rejection of the larger nation they live in in favor of small tribes based on racial and sexual identities and similar cultures. Development of stoic emotional states to guard against the pain of possible failure. And finally, deliberate social isolation. Could you create these turbulent fields deliberately?
paragraphs.zh: 拒绝他们所居住的更大国家，转而选择基于种族与性身份及相似文化的小型部落。培养斯多葛式的情感状态，以抵御可能失败所带来的痛苦。以及最后，刻意的社会隔离。你能刻意制造出这些动荡的场域吗？

paragraphs.en: Their use is obvious for warfare and social control. In 2000, two Rand Corporation strategists, John Archilla and David Ronfeld, took that up in a document called swarming and the future of conflict. They argued that warfare had evolved into what they called swarming. small dispersed network units striking from every direction with no fixed front. They say explicitly that the clear's working model of a swarm isn't military at all.
paragraphs.zh: 其在战争与社会控制方面的应用显而易见。2000年，兰德公司的两位战略家约翰·阿奇拉和戴维·罗恩费尔德在一份名为《蜂群与冲突的未来》的文件中探讨了这一问题。他们认为，战争已经演变为他们所称的“蜂群”模式，即小型分散的网络化单元从各个方向发起攻击，且没有固定的战线。他们明确指出，蜂群的运作模式根本不属于军事范畴。

paragraphs.en: It's the activist NGO network. They named the Zapatista movement in Mexico and the anti-milic protest in Serbia as examples. In other words, the turbulent field Fred Emery described is exactly the field in which color revolutions now flourish. Schwall group mobs and focused media propaganda creating the turbulent fields.
paragraphs.zh: 这指的是活动人士非政府组织网络。他们以墨西哥萨帕塔运动和塞尔维亚反米洛舍维奇抗议为例。换言之，弗雷德·埃默里所描述的动荡场域，正是如今颜色革命得以蓬勃发展的场域。施瓦尔集团暴徒与定向媒体宣传正在制造这些动荡场域。

paragraphs.en: The targeted population faced with massive social unrest engineered through the swarm becomes passive and regresses to an infantile state in which their own satisfaction and survival are primary. NATO's cognitive warfare doctrine introduced in 2021 takes that a step even further. It says the human mind is the sixth and most important domain of all warfare. Cognitive warfare's aim, get this, is to turn its targets into weapons its operators control, human weapons.
paragraphs.zh: 面对由蜂群操纵引发的大规模社会动荡，目标人群将变得被动，并退行至一种以自身满足与生存为优先的婴儿般状态。北约于2021年推出的认知战学说更进一步。该学说指出，人类心智是所有作战域中第六个且最为关键的域。认知战的目的在于——请注意——将目标转化为其操控者完全掌控的武器，即“人类武器”。

paragraphs.en: While creating a controlled media environment limits the choices of an adversary. That is what has been deployed for 10 years against President Donald Trump is what the current State Department official Darren Bey accurately describes as a color revolution. Journalist Richard Poe has thoroughly documented the origins of these color revolutions in the warfare techniques of British secret intelligence. But these techniques fall apart once the cause of the societal turbulence and anxiety is accurately identified.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管建立受控的媒体环境会限制对手的选择，但过去十年针对唐纳德·特朗普总统所部署的手段，正是现任美国国务院官员达伦·贝准确称之为“颜色革命”的东西。记者理查德·波已详尽记录了这些颜色革命起源于英国秘密情报机构的作战技术。然而，一旦准确查明引发社会动荡与焦虑的根源，这些手段便会不攻自破。

paragraphs.en: Once it's clear to the victims that they've been played and reality is injected into the situation. Here's Stephen Miller doing a very good job of doing just that on Saturday. >> This is a struggle for the survival of America. It's that serious. It's that real. [snorts] What you talked about, abolishing police, abolishing borders, abolishing ICE, abolishing fossil fuels, gutting the Department of War, these actions collectively would bring America to its knees. > 这是一场关乎美国存亡的斗争。事情严重到了这个地步，真实到了这个地步。[嗤笑] 你们所谈论的那些——废除警察、拆除边境、取缔移民与海关执法局（ICE）、废除化石燃料、掏空战争部——这些行动加在一起，足以让美国陷入绝境。
paragraphs.zh: 当受害者们看清自己被人蒙骗，现实被重新注入这一局面时，真相便大白于天下。周六，斯蒂芬·米勒就很好地做到了这一点。

paragraphs.en: It would us. It would crush us. It would destroy everything 250 years of patriots fought, bled, and died for. The people at home, everything that makes your life better, Donald Trump is delivering on and fighting for.
paragraphs.zh: 它会伤害我们。它会压垮我们。它会摧毁两百五十年来爱国者们为之战斗、流血和牺牲的一切。对于国内的民众，对于一切能让你的生活变得更好的事物，唐纳德·特朗普都在兑现承诺并为之奋斗。

paragraphs.en: Record tax relief, zero illegal immigration, the largest reduction in murder since 1900, the lowest violent crime rates that have ever been recorded. No tax on tips, no tax on social security, no tax on overtime. rebuilding the military, taking the fight to the drug cartels to keep fentinel from killing our families and our children. Issue after issue, President Trump is fighting for our families. And what do they want to do?
paragraphs.zh: 创纪录的减税，零非法移民，自1900年以来谋杀案降幅最大，有记录以来最低的暴力犯罪率。小费不征税，社会保障金不征税，加班费不征税。重建军队，主动出击打击毒品贩运集团，防止芬太尼杀害我们的家人和孩子。在各项议题上，特朗普总统都在为我们的家庭而战。而他们想做什么呢？

paragraphs.en: They want to hand over our nation to illegal aliens, criminals, jihadists, and communists. Now, let's talk about the cognitive warriors biggest mistake regarding the USS Lincoln. In attacking the mental toughness of our troops, they evoke something fundamental to American identity and they simultaneously showed their own weak character and delusions of our reality. Now, to me, the war in Iran is the ultimate just war.
paragraphs.zh: 他们想把我们的国家拱手交给非法移民、罪犯、圣战分子和共产主义者。现在，让我们谈谈认知战战士在林肯号航母问题上犯下的最大错误。在攻击我军心理韧性的同时，他们不仅唤起了美国身份认同中最根本的东西，也暴露了他们自身的性格软弱以及对我国现实的妄想。在我看来，对伊朗的战争才是终极的正义之战。

paragraphs.en: It is destroying the globalist petrod dollar system that almost destroyed us under Barack Obama and Joe Biden and clearing the way for a new Middle East built on advanced technologies and desalinization, not oil and gas for London's profit. You might disagree with me on that. The war has also stalled at the radic drops in the inflation which Trump inherited from Joe Biden. But one thing no American would do, at least until now, is put out propaganda pieces portraying the men and women fighting this war as mentally unbalanced children complaining about food and laundry in a war zone, let alone the Democratic Party or mainstream media doing that.
paragraphs.zh: 它正在摧毁全球主义的石油美元体系，该体系在奥巴马和拜登执政期间几乎将我们毁掉；同时，它也在为一个新的中东铺平道路，这个新中东将建立在先进技术和海水淡化技术之上，而非为了伦敦的利益继续依赖石油和天然气。你可能对此持有不同看法。战争也陷入了停滞，而通胀的急剧下降——这是特朗普从拜登那里继承来的——也是如此。但有一件事，至少到目前为止，没有哪个美国人会去做，那就是发布宣传文章，将在这场战争中作战的男女士兵描绘成在战区抱怨伙食和洗衣问题的心理失衡的孩子，更不用说民主党或主流媒体会这么做。

paragraphs.en: In effect, they say that those putting their lives on the line for us are overprivileged weenies. The Iranians, of course, immediately picked up on it, as anyone with a brain knew they would. A core American belief is that we are made to be strong and resilient in the most adverse conditions. The woke feminization of culture embraced by Joe Biden and Barack Obama says that belief is wrong.
paragraphs.zh: 换言之，他们实际上是在说，那些为我们冒死奋战的人不过是些被宠坏的软蛋。伊朗方面当然立刻抓住了这一点，但凡有点脑子的人都能预料到他们会这么做。美国文化的一个核心信念是：无论身处何种极端恶劣的环境，我们都天生就具备坚强与坚韧的特质。而拜登与奥巴马所推崇的“觉醒”文化女性化倾向，却宣称这一信念是错误的。

paragraphs.en: The weakness, victimhood, even criminality are virtuous. But that's beginning to produce popular revulsion against everything the Democrat party touches. And it's the center of the USS Lincoln fake narrative. That's what makes the Lincoln narrative just a step too far for the sigh warriors.
paragraphs.zh: 软弱、受害者身份，甚至犯罪行为都被视为美德。但这正开始引发公众对民主党所触及的一切事物的强烈反感。而这正是“林肯号”虚假叙事的核心。这也正是让“叹息战士”觉得林肯叙事“越界一步”的原因。

paragraphs.en: It reveals both their own perverted mindset and the subservient culture they'd have us embrace. It's a mistake in playing with popular profiles equivalent to Hillary Clinton's use of the term deplorable to describe half of America. Once you see how the psychological warfare manuals work, you understand why staying on the internet or reading mainstream media produces such anxiety and passivity. They're designed to do just that.
paragraphs.zh: 它既暴露了他们自身扭曲的心态，也揭示了他们企图让我们接受的顺从文化。这种迎合大众心理标签的做法是个错误，其性质等同于希拉里·克林顿用“可悲的人”一词来形容美国一半人口。一旦你看透了心理战手册的运作机制，你就会明白，为什么长期上网或阅读主流媒体内容会引发如此强烈的焦虑与被动。这一切正是为此而设计的。

paragraphs.en: The turbulence, as they say, is the message. You will also see why the Trump administration has been careful to lay out the factual evidence about each step of the civil war the population has experienced over the past decade. From Russia gate to Ukraine gate and impeachment to the George Floyd riots and the rigged 2020 election in January 6th to the co mandates and censorship to the war on MAGA and Trump himself after he left office. The president and his people have moved aggressively against the apparatus that ran the sigh war.
paragraphs.zh: 正如人们所说，动荡本身就是信号。你也会明白，为何特朗普政府一直谨慎地梳理并公布事实证据，以回应过去十年间民众所经历的这场内战的每一个阶段。从通俄门到通乌门及弹劾案，从乔治·弗洛伊德骚乱与被操纵的2020年大选及1月6日事件，到强制令与网络审查，再到卸任后针对“让美国再次伟大”（MAGA）运动及特朗普本人的“战争”。总统及其团队已对操控这场“影子战争”的体制机构采取了强硬的反击行动。

paragraphs.en: Darren Bey, for example, the man who accurately defined the operation against Trump as a color revolution when he was a journalist, now runs the Institute of Peace and the State Department's public diplomacy branch. Those things and the National Endowment for Democracy is where the color revolution's apparatus sat. Now we just have to use what we've learned to massively destabilize them between now and the midterms. In addition to creating an election too big to rig, we might also free those victims of their cyborg who have yet to see the light.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，达伦·贝（Darren Bey）——这位在担任记者时曾准确将针对特朗普的行动定性为颜色革命的人——如今掌管着和平研究所与国务院公共外交局。这些机构以及国家民主基金会，正是颜色革命的运作体系所在。眼下，我们只需运用所学，在中期选举前彻底动摇他们的根基。除了打造一场规模大到无法操纵的选举外，我们或许还能解救那些被其赛博格系统操控、尚未觉醒的受害者。

paragraphs.en: That may seem audacious, but so did wiping out the city of London's financial control in 20 months. And unlike the weeny cyborg guys, we Americans are actually strong and resilient. We need your help to help us grow. Please contribute as much as you can to make that happen.
paragraphs.zh: 这听起来或许有些大胆，但二十个月内终结伦敦的金融控制，当初看来也同样大胆。而且，与那些弱小的赛博格家伙们不同，我们美国人其实非常强大且坚韧。我们需要你们的帮助来推动我们的发展。请尽可能多地做出贡献，助其实现。

paragraphs.en: This has been your Monday update. I'll see you again on Thursday.
paragraphs.zh: 以上就是本周一的更新。我们周四再见。

articles.title: THE OUTLAW LEDGER: Canada Is Not a Partner — It's an Empire

paragraphs.en: Last night, President Trump announced a three-day pause in a war, and it wasn't about Iran. Here's what he posted. I have paused the 50% tariffs against Canada that were scheduled to kick in tomorrow morning for a 3-day period based on the fact that Canada and the United States, subject to the finalization of documents, have a deal. The Great Keystone XL pipeline, long ago killed by sleepy Joe Biden, may be awoken from the grave.
paragraphs.zh: 昨晚，特朗普总统宣布暂停一场“战争”三天，但这与伊朗无关。以下是他发帖的内容：我已暂停原定明早生效的对加拿大50%关税，暂停期为三天。这是基于加美两国已达成协议，仅待相关文件最终敲定。曾被“瞌睡乔”拜登早早扼杀的“大 Keystone XL 管道”项目，或许将从坟墓中苏醒。

paragraphs.en: Now, the media will focus on the Keystone pipeline aspect of this and whatever else is evolving from the ongoing US MCA trade negotiations, but there is something much bigger going on. And it ranges from what White House adviser Peter Navaro accused Canada of of being one of the countries engaged in a basically modern form of smuggling to a Canadian member of parliament who's organizing a petition to throw the US ambassador to Canada out of the country. This isn't a trade dispute. This is a war and it's been going on a lot longer than the conflict with Iran.
paragraphs.zh: 眼下，媒体将聚焦于此事中的基斯通管道问题，以及正在进行的 美墨加协定(USMCA)贸易谈判中衍生出的其他事项，但背后实则酝酿着更为重大的事态。其表现从白宫顾问彼得·纳瓦罗指控加拿大参与了一种近乎现代的走私形式，到一名加拿大国会议员正组织请愿要求将美国驻加拿大大使驱逐出境，不一而足。这绝非一场贸易争端。这是一场战争，而且其持续时间远比与伊朗的冲突要长得多。

paragraphs.en: I'm Susan Kokinda and I've tracked how the British Empire rebrands itself in order to keep up the war against American sovereignty. That's what we follow here at Prometheian Action. And if that's a fight you want to be in on, hit those like, share, and subscribe buttons. Here's what I'm going to cover today.
paragraphs.zh: 我是苏珊·科金达。我一直追踪英国帝国如何通过重塑自身形象，来继续其对美国主权的战争。这正是我们“普罗米修斯行动”团队所关注的重点。如果你也想加入这场斗争，请点赞、分享并订阅。以下是我今天要探讨的内容。

paragraphs.en: One, the outlaw ledger. That is what Canada actually does versus what it says it does. two, how the speeches of two cabinet officers, one American and one Canadian, highlight the real battle lines, and three, who's behind the recall petition and the larger strategy. So last week, Canada's interior minister Melanie Jolie was in London at Chattam House selling Canada to the assembled audience as a quote stable, grown-up, reliable partner, as opposed to the United States, of course. But here is how that grown-up partner operates.
paragraphs.zh: 第一，违法账本。这正是加拿大实际所为与其口头宣称之间的真实写照。第二，一位美国内阁官员与一位加拿大内阁官员的演讲如何凸显了真正的战线；第三，罢免请愿书背后的推手及其更大的战略意图。上周，加拿大内政部长梅拉妮·朱利在伦敦查塔姆研究所向与会者推介加拿大，将其塑造为“稳定、成熟、可靠的伙伴”，当然，这是与美国相对立的。但这位“成熟伙伴”的实际运作方式却是这样的。

paragraphs.en: Four days ago, the White House put out a report called the Great Trans Shipment Scam. And here's what the president's trade adviser, Peter Navaro, said about it. >> Uh, but what happened beginning uh immediately in 2018 uh is that China strategically began to develop methods of of what's called trans shipping. It's basically a modern form of smuggling. >> As Navaro was describing how the Chinese repackage their goods into products that are produced in countries with lower tariffs in order to quote smuggle them in. The broadcast was showing just what countries are involved and Canada is near the top of the list.
paragraphs.zh:
四天前，白宫发布了一份名为《大转运骗局》的报告。以下是总统贸易顾问彼得·纳瓦罗对此事的评论：
“但从2018年伊始，中国就开始有策略地开发一种被称为‘转运’的方法。这基本上是一种现代的走私形式。”
当纳瓦罗描述中国如何将商品重新包装，使其变成在关税较低的国家生产的产品，从而以“走私”方式运入时，电视画面正展示着具体涉及的国家名单，而加拿大就位居前列。

paragraphs.en: But that's not the only list that Canada is on. When the administration escalated its tariff strategy back in July, it targeted countries which failed to enforce measures banning goods produced by forced or slave labor. Canada is on the short list of six countries which failed to enforce their own laws. Then there are the dirty money flows which are the hallmark of the empire's deregulated financial system.
paragraphs.zh: 但这并非加拿大被列入的唯一名单。七月，当政府升级其关税策略时，其目标直指那些未能执行禁止强迫劳动或奴隶劳动所产商品措施的国家。加拿大位列未能执行本国法律的六国短名单之中。此外，还有那些非法资金流动，这正是该帝国放松管制金融体系的典型特征。

paragraphs.en: They have a name for the Canadian side of it. It's called snowwashing. Transparency International Canada put the problem bluntly. Quote, "There are more rigorous checks to obtain a library card than there are to set up a shell company." And they said, "This leaves Canada, in their words, with quote, some of the weakest corporate transparency laws in the world." And the money that gets washed is not petty cash.
paragraphs.zh: 加拿大方面对此有个专门的称呼，叫做“雪洗”（snowwashing）。透明国际加拿大分会直言不讳地指出了这一问题。他们表示：“办理一张图书馆借书卡所经历的审查，比注册一家空壳公司还要严格。”他们指出：“这导致加拿大‘拥有世界上最薄弱的公司透明度法律之一’。”而且，这些被洗的钱绝非小数目。

paragraphs.en: British Columbia's Cullen Commission, a full public inquiry, whose final report was released in June 2022, documented what investigators called the Vancouver model, cartel and triad money from the Sinaloa and CGNG cartels and Chinese triads laundered through casinos, luxury cars, and real estate. In BC real estate alone, the estimates ran from 800 million to over 5 billion a year. Now, if that reminds you of how the city of London and its offshore Caribbean islands, house drug cartel and terrorist money, including the IRGC, it should. That is the Empire's business model.
paragraphs.zh: 不列颠哥伦比亚省卡伦委员会是一项全面的公开调查，其最终报告于2022年6月发布。报告记录了调查人员所称的“温哥华模式”，即来自锡那罗亚和CGNG卡特尔以及中国三合会的卡特尔与三合会资金，正通过赌场、豪华汽车和房地产进行洗钱。仅在BC省房地产领域，相关估计金额每年在8亿至超过50亿之间。如果这让你联想到伦敦及其海外加勒比岛屿如何容纳毒品卡特尔和恐怖主义资金（包括伊斯兰革命卫队），那并不奇怪。这正是“帝国”的商业模式。

paragraphs.en: So that's just part of the wrap sheet on Canada, the stable, reliable, grown-up partner in Minister Jolie's words. So the US MCA fight, the trade negotiations that everyone is watching, that's one flank. Canada doesn't cheat on trade because of sloppy enforcement. It uses trade to erode American economic sovereignty by design.
paragraphs.zh: 这不过是关于加拿大概况中的一小部分——用乔利部长的话说，它是“稳定、可靠、成熟的伙伴”。因此，美国MCA之争，以及备受瞩目的贸易谈判，只是其中一方面。加拿大在贸易上作弊，并非因为执法松懈，而是蓄意利用贸易来侵蚀美国的经济主权。

paragraphs.en: That isn't a trading partner. That's an outlaw with a flag staple to it. Now, if you want to track the British Empire's long war against American sovereignty before it hits the headlines, subscribe to Prometheian Actions free newsletter. The link is in the description.
paragraphs.zh: 那可不是什么贸易伙伴。那是个披着国旗外衣的亡命之徒。现在，如果你想在大英帝国对美利坚主权的长期战争登上头条之前抢先追踪其动向，请订阅 Prometheian Actions 的免费通讯。链接就在简介里。

paragraphs.en: Because none of this is really about tariffs or forced labor lists. It's about two different systems. Now, watch when you put two speeches side by side. One happened in Midland, Texas by our energy secretary in front of oil and gas workers and the other by Secretary Jolie again at Chattam House in London in front of Britain's premier foreign policy establishment.
paragraphs.zh: 因为这一切本质上与关税或强迫劳动清单无关。它关乎的是两套不同的体系。现在，不妨将两场演讲并列对比来看。一场是我们能源部长在得克萨斯州米德兰市向油气工人发表的演讲，另一场则是乔莉部长再次在伦敦查塔姆研究所向英国顶尖外交政策圈发表的演讲。

paragraphs.en: Same subject, energy and they couldn't be farther apart. Here's what Chris Wright, the US energy secretary said. >> Think about that. Human life expectancy at birth globally was was 30 years 20,000 years ago. It was 30 years 200 years ago. > 想想看。两万年前，全球人均预期寿命是30岁。两百年前，也还是30岁。
paragraphs.zh: 同一个话题——能源，但两者的看法却天差地别。以下是美国能源部长克里斯·赖特所说的话：

paragraphs.en: The most transformative force ever to visit human civilization. Well, besides family and faith and morality and those things that power our iners, but the most transformative thing to the physical condition of humans ever is oil and natural gas. Today, life expecties over 70 years. All of that rise happened with the rise of the oil and gas industry. >> Let that really sink in.
paragraphs.zh: 有史以来对人类文明产生过最深远变革的力量。当然，除了家庭、信仰、道德以及那些支撑我们内在精神的事物之外，有史以来对人类身体状况产生过最深刻变革的，无疑是石油和天然气。如今，人类的预期寿命已超过70岁。这一增长完全是伴随着石油和天然气工业的崛起而发生的。>> 请让这一点深深印在你的脑海里。

paragraphs.en: Wright isn't talking about barrels or pipelines. He's talking about why your grandmother's grandmother died at 30 and you didn't. That's energy as a civilization, not a commodity. And he didn't stop at history. He pointed to a new iron ore mine opening in Minnesota, the first one in 50 years, and a steel plant going up nearby that he called the largest in the world.
paragraphs.zh: 赖特谈的并非石油桶或输油管道。他探讨的是，为何你的曾祖母三十岁便离世，而你却能活到现在。这才是能源在文明发展中的意义，而非单纯的商品。他的论述并未止步于历史。他举出明尼苏达州一座新铁矿的投产——这是五十年来首座新矿；以及附近正在建设的一座钢铁厂，他称其为全球最大的钢铁厂。

paragraphs.en: Re-industrialization, this is the core of the president's economic policy, and it depends on modern sources of energy. Then he made the moral point, quote, a billion people live these awesome lives that we have. 7 billion people want to live the awesome lives that we have here. Now go to London where Melanie Jolie revealed Canada's new strategy. Of course, she wasn't freelancing.
paragraphs.zh: 再工业化是总统经济政策的核心，且其依赖于现代能源。接着，他提出了一个道义层面的观点，并说道：“十亿人正过着像我们这样令人向往的生活。七十亿人也都渴望在这里过上同样令人向往的生活。”随后，在伦敦，梅拉妮·乔利公布了加拿大的新战略。当然，她并没有擅自行动。

paragraphs.en: She was channeling Mark Carney's line about how Canada is leading the middle powers in a new alliance against the economic hedgeimons, namely the United States and China. And so industrial policy is the new geopolitics. We've entered an era of geoindustrialization where doing business together is no longer through only private markets. It is also very much through governmentto decisions where decisions are linked to geopolitical choices. >> So catch that new phrase geoindustrialization.
paragraphs.zh: 她是在复述马克·卡尼的观点，即加拿大正引领中等强国组建新联盟，以对抗经济霸权——也就是美国和中国。因此，产业政策已成为新的地缘政治。我们已进入一个“地缘工业化”时代，共同开展商业合作不再仅仅依赖私人市场，而是很大程度上通过政府间决策来实现，而这些决策又与地缘政治选择紧密相连。>> 所以，请留意这个新词：“地缘工业化”。

paragraphs.en: Now what is the significance of that? It's the extension into economics of the British Empire's policy of geopolitics. In other words, run your foreign policy by treating nations as dispensable pawns on a chessboard, destroying them through wars or color revolutions, whatever is needed to keep the empire in control. Jolie says that geoindustrialization is Canada's economic policy and especially its energy policy and it's based on the same foundation.
paragraphs.zh: 那么，这究竟意味着什么？这实质上是将大英帝国的地缘政治政策延伸至经济领域。换言之，就是以棋盘上可弃置的棋子来对待各国，进而推行外交政策；通过战争或“颜色革命”将其摧毁，不惜一切手段以维持帝国的掌控。乔利指出，“地缘工业化”是加拿大的经济政策，尤其是其能源政策，而这一政策同样建立在上述基础之上。

paragraphs.en: Use economics or in this case energy as a weapon in the fight to maintain globalism in its new Mark Carney 2.0 form. Now Jolie comes by her imperial views honestly. Regular viewers of Prometheian action are not going to be surprised to find out that she studied at Oxford on a British government scholarship. So her speech at Chattam House was kind of a homecoming.
paragraphs.zh: 将经济学，或者说在此语境下的能源，作为武器，用于捍卫其全新“马克·卡尼2.0”模式的全球主义。朱莉对这种帝国主义立场可谓毫不掩饰。常看“普罗米修斯”节目的观众，得知她曾凭借英国政府奖学金赴牛津求学，绝不会感到意外。因此，她在查塔姆宫的演讲，某种意义上可谓一次“归乡”。

paragraphs.en: Contrast her speech to Secretary Wright. He's talking about energy as a critical element in advancing civilization and creating a better life potentially for the 8 billion people on this planet. Wright wants to build civilization. Jolie wants to manage the empire's control.
paragraphs.zh: 将她的演讲与莱特部长的演讲作对比。他谈到，能源是推动文明进步、并有望为地球上的80亿人创造更美好生活的关键要素。莱特意在建设文明，而朱莉则意在维持帝国的控制。

paragraphs.en: One produces the other positions. And that is what is really behind the trade disputes between the United States and Canada. This is not just one nation maneuvering for a more favorable trade deal for the benefit of its people. This is geopolitics in industrial terms.
paragraphs.zh: 一方造就了另一方的地位。这正是美加贸易争端背后的真正原因。这不仅仅是某个国家为了本国人民的利益而谋求更有利的贸易协议，而是工业层面的地缘政治博弈。

paragraphs.en: Which is why US ambassador Pete Hora is not very popular in Canada. Now, I watched Hoaxra up close when he was chairman of the Michigan Republican Party, and it was clear when President Trump chose him that he wanted a bulldog for ambassador, someone who wouldn't back down in this war. The Empire has figured that out. And so, this summer, a campaign began to get rid of him.
paragraphs.zh: 这就是为什么美国驻加拿大大使皮特·霍拉在加拿大并不受欢迎。我曾在他担任密歇根州共和党主席时近距离观察过他，很明显，特朗普总统选择他时，就是想要一只“斗牛犬”式的大使，一个在这场战争中绝不退缩的人。帝国已经看透了这一点。因此，今年夏天，一场旨在让他下台的运动就此展开。

paragraphs.en: More than 200,000 Canadians have now signed a formal petition to the House of Commons demanding their government declare Pete Hora persona nonrada. the diplomatic term for throwing an ambassador out of the country. So, who started this? Elizabeth May, a leader of Canada's Green Party. She was born in Connecticut to a British father who hated living in the United States.
paragraphs.zh: 目前已有超过20万加拿大人在正式请愿书上签名并提交至加拿大下议院，要求政府宣布皮特·霍拉为“不受欢迎的人”。这是外交术语，意为将大使驱逐出境。那么，是谁发起的呢？伊丽莎白·梅伊，加拿大绿党领袖。她出生于康涅狄格州，父亲是英国人，且非常厌恶在美国生活。

paragraphs.en: So, the family left for Canada and she renounced her American citizenship altogether. She spent the next four decades as a professional environmental activist running the Sierra Club of Canada and campaigning against the oil, the gas, and the industry that built the modern world before becoming leader of Green Party. Now, the petition can't actually expel anyone. It forces the government to file a written response.
paragraphs.zh: 于是，这家人移居加拿大，她彻底放弃了美国国籍。在接下来的四十年里，她作为专职环保人士，担任加拿大塞拉俱乐部负责人，积极反对石油、天然气以及塑造现代世界的工业，之后成为绿党领袖。不过，这项请愿书实际上并不能驱逐任何人。它只能迫使政府提交书面答复。

paragraphs.en: But the Canadian government has been silent so far. And read what the petition actually objects to. It attacks Hoaxra for normalizing talk of Canada as a 51st state and for the fact that officials from the movement for Alberta's independence met with the US State Department three times over the past year. Think about what that tells you.
paragraphs.zh: 但加拿大政府迄今为止保持沉默。不妨看看这份请愿书实际反对的究竟是什么。它指责 Hoaxra 两点：一是将“加拿大成为美国第51个州”的说法常态化，二是阿尔伯塔独立运动的官员在过去一年里曾三次与美国国务院会面。想想这说明了什么。

paragraphs.en: The province the establishment is most afraid of losing is Alberta, the one that produces the energy. The one, by the way, where the Keystone pipeline originates. Which brings us to a question that the petition can't answer. If Canada is so eager to remove our representative from their country, what exactly is their representative doing here?
paragraphs.zh: 建制派最害怕失去的省份是阿尔伯塔省，也就是那个能源大省。顺便提一句，Keystone 输油管道正是发源于此。这就引出了一个请愿书无法回答的问题：既然加拿大如此急切地要把我们的代表赶出他们的国家，那他们的代表又究竟在这里做什么呢？

paragraphs.en: Let's go back to what Melanie Jolie is up to on this side of the pond. Here's what she told Chattam House she is doing. I was in Boston last week uh meeting much more with the Democrats uh but also I will be heading uh to many different uh cities Chicago uh going to Texas uh Florida in the next uh few weeks. So um and understanding also what's the position of different lawmakers uh within states but also at the federal level.
paragraphs.zh: 让我们把目光转回大西洋彼岸梅拉妮·乔利的动向。以下是她在查塔姆研究所透露的行程：我上周在波士顿，主要与民主党人进行了会面；此外，在未来几周，我还将前往芝加哥、德克萨斯州和佛罗里达州等多个城市，同时了解各州及联邦层面不同立法者的立场。

paragraphs.en: So, a cabinet minister of a foreign government is moving through American cities in the middle of a trade war, sitting down with the political opposition, taking inventory of which of our own in Congress and our own state houses might take Canada's side against our own elected government. So, this isn't just about the US MCA or tariffs. Canada doesn't cheat on trade because of sloppy enforcement. It uses trade to erode American economic sovereignty.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，一个外国政府的内阁部长正穿梭于美国各城市，在贸易战期间与政治反对派会面，摸底我们国会和州议会中哪些人可能会站在加拿大一边，对抗我们民选政府。所以，这不仅仅关乎美墨加协定或关税问题。加拿大在贸易中作弊并非因为执法不严，而是有意利用贸易来侵蚀美国的经济主权。

paragraphs.en: And it's not an accident. It's the design. This is a fight between two systems. One outlined by Chris Wright to build the modern world for Americans and for the 7 billion people who need energy who aspire to have what we have. and the one outlined by Jolie deploying the empire's new geoindustrial strategy while a Green Party leader tries to remove the American ambassador who won't back down.
paragraphs.zh: 这并非偶然，而是设计使然。这是一场两大体系之间的较量。一方是克里斯·赖特所勾勒的，旨在为美国人以及那七十亿亟需能源且渴望拥有我们生活水平的人们构建现代世界；另一方则是乔莉所勾勒的、旨在部署帝国新地缘工业战略的体系。与此同时，一位绿党领袖正试图罢免那位毫不退缩的美国大使。

paragraphs.en: That's the battle writ large and it's the difference between these two countries. One is a sovereign republic. The other is an imperial outpost and the man running it is the empire's own central banker. Donald Trump understands that and so do we.
paragraphs.zh: 这场斗争清晰可见，也正是这两个国家之间的根本差异所在。一个是主权共和国，另一个则是帝国的前哨站，而掌控它的人正是该帝国自己的央行行长。唐纳德·特朗普深知这一点，我们也同样如此。

paragraphs.en: So, if you want to be part of that fight, join Prometheian Action as a supporting or a contributing member. This has been your Wednesday update. Thanks for watching.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，如果你想加入这场斗争，欢迎成为普罗米修斯行动的支持会员或贡献会员。以上就是本期周三更新。感谢观看。

articles.title: Kissinger Exposed: How Trump Dismantled 50 Years of British Mideast Policy

paragraphs.en: Yesterday, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessant delivered a message to the government of Iran and to the world. >> At the president's orders, we have raised the level even again and watch this space for more announcements coming next week because we are going to apply measures like have never been seen in the history of economic isolation on a country. That is an execution of a policy that has been years in the making. And a week earlier, Bessant told you what it was. >> The straight is never going back to the way it was because the Iranians have used or tried to use it as a choke point. What we are going to see over the next two years, the strait's going to become irrelevant. > 遵照总统的命令，我们再次提升了措施级别。请密切关注下周即将发布的更多公告，因为我们将对一国实施经济孤立史上前所未有的措施。此举旨在落实一项酝酿已久的政策。一周前，贝桑特曾向你们透露过具体内容。 > 该海峡的局势将永远无法恢复如初，因为伊朗已经使用或试图将其作为战略咽喉。在未来两年内，我们将看到该海峡将失去其战略意义。
paragraphs.zh: 昨日，财政部长斯科特·贝桑特向伊朗政府及全世界传达了一项信息。

paragraphs.en: It is going to become just another body of water. >> This isn't just about Iran. It's about the end of a British choke point that's been used as a weapon in service of a policy which has kept the region in flames for decades now. If you're living in your social media feeds, you're probably getting whiplash. The straits are open.
paragraphs.zh: 它终将沦为一片寻常的水域。>> 这绝不只是伊朗的问题。这关乎一条英国控制的战略咽喉的终结。多年来，该要道被当作武器，服务于某项政策，致使该地区数十年来战火不断。如果你整天刷着社交媒体，恐怕早就被这频繁更迭的消息弄得晕头转向了。海峡已开放。

paragraphs.en: The straits are closed. America is winning. America is losing. That's not the story.
paragraphs.zh: 海峡已关闭。美国赢了。美国输了。那并不是真相。

paragraphs.en: It's a distraction from the real one. The real story is much bigger. And it didn't start 6 months ago. It started 50 years ago.
paragraphs.zh: 这只是在转移人们对真正事件的注意力。真正的事件要宏大得多。而且它并非始于六个月前，而是始于五十年前。

paragraphs.en: And last month, a Lebanese diplomat blew the lid off that story. He named the names and he did it at the empire's own Chattam House. I'm Susan Kokinda. I followed that story 50 years ago when few others did.
paragraphs.zh: 上个月，一位黎巴嫩外交官揭露了那则报道的内幕。他点名了具体人物，而且是在帝国自己的查塔姆研究所公开进行的。我是苏珊·科金达。50年前，当鲜有人问津时，我就已开始追踪那则报道。

paragraphs.en: So, if you want to follow this, hit those like, subscribe, and share buttons so we can stay in touch and reach more people. Here's what I'm going to cover. First, what our Treasury and Energy Secretary said about the end of that choke point. Second, the indictment delivered [clears throat] at Chattam House.
paragraphs.zh: 所以，如果你想持续关注，请点击点赞、订阅和分享按钮，以便我们保持联系并触达更多观众。接下来我将主要讲解以下内容：第一，我们的财政部长和能源部长关于结束这一关键瓶颈的表态；第二，在查塔姆宫宣读的起诉书[清嗓子]。

paragraphs.en: And third, what President Trump is building to replace it. So start with Scott Besson's comment again. The straight will never go back to the way it was. Energy Secretary Chris Wright described how that is already happening.
paragraphs.zh: 第三，特朗普总统正在构建什么来取代它。那么，让我们再次从斯科特·贝森特的言论说起。现状将永远无法回到从前。能源部长克里斯·赖特详细说明了这一变化是如何正在发生的。

paragraphs.en: In an interview with Fox News, Wright addressed the panic mongering in the commentary. So, you're saying that because of the US military escorts and because some of these ships go dark going through the straight that those numbers of these tracking agencies are not accurate. >> Exactly. Exactly. They're they're trying the best they can, but almost all of these ships have their aispers are off, so they're dark.
paragraphs.zh: 在接受福克斯新闻采访时，怀特就评论中煽动恐慌的情绪作出了回应。所以，您的意思是，由于有美国军舰护航，且部分船只通过海峡时会关闭信号，导致那些追踪机构的数据并不准确？>> 没错。没错。他们已经在尽力了，但几乎所有这些船只都关闭了AIS信号，所以它们都处于“隐身”状态。

paragraphs.en: They're under escort. Um, and it's so it's a different shipping operation than we had before the conflict, but it's eight or nine million barrels a day on a running average are going through the straight. Plus, you've got to add the 6 million barrels a day that are being diverted via pipelines and and those pipelines are being expanded as well. >> So, the real gap is 5 to 6 million barrels, not the 15 million the doomsday commentators keep repeating. The interviewer kept hammering on the gotcha question. who controls the straight right now.
paragraphs.zh: 它们正由护航舰艇陪同。嗯，而且现在的航运作业与冲突前有所不同，但平均每天仍有八到九百万桶原油通过该海峡。此外，还必须加上通过管道转运的每天六百万桶，而且这些管道也在扩建中。>> 所以，实际的缺口是五到六百万桶，而不是末日论评论员们反复炒作的那一千五百万桶。采访者一直紧咬着一个陷阱问题不放：现在到底是谁控制着这条海峡？

paragraphs.en: And Chris Wright flipped it from the tactical to the strategic. >> But their ability to cause difficulties are declining. Our ability to escort and bring products out of that region is growing. They they have they they have sort of one one card and it's shrinking in size. >> One shrinking card. That's not a choke point anymore.
paragraphs.zh: 克里斯·赖特将其从战术层面转向了战略层面。>> 但他们制造障碍的能力正在下降。我们护航并将货物运出该区域的能力正在增强。他们……他们手里大概只有一张牌，而且这张牌的作用正在缩水。>> 一张不断缩水的牌。这已经不再是咽喉要道了。

paragraphs.en: That's what Bessant meant when he forecast the future irrelevancy of the strait. But the situation on the ground in Hormuse is just one flank in the overall strategy. Economic isolation that Bessant spoke of is the final phase of a strategy that he's been carrying out since March 2025. >> And we've been going after, as you said, their bank accounts, crypto wallets, assets around the world, cut cutting off payments into both the leadership and the regime and the government itself. So while Treasury was quietly strangling the Iranian regime's economic networks, the US was creating alternatives to the oil coming through the strait. > 正如你所说，我们一直在针对他们的银行账户、加密货币钱包以及全球各地的资产，切断向领导层、政权乃至政府本身输送的资金。因此，在美国财政部悄然扼杀伊朗政权经济网络的同时，美国也在积极寻找替代经由该海峡的石油来源。
paragraphs.zh: 贝桑特预言该海峡未来将失去重要性，指的就是这个意思。但霍尔木兹的实地局势仅仅是整体战略中的一个侧翼。贝桑特所提及的经济孤立，正是他自2025年3月起推行的一项战略的最终阶段。

paragraphs.en: Alternatives like unccoring our own energy production, like liberating Venezuela from Maduro so it could produce oil and augment US capabilities, like creating a world where other Gulf states could liberate themselves from the status quo. The UAE walked away from the old OPEC quota system and start pumping more on its own terms. Iraq recently negotiated deals with US companies to build pipelines which will bypass the straight of Hormuse permanently. That's the same 50 to 70% shift that Bessant flagged and it's happening inside a 2-year window.
paragraphs.zh: 替代方案包括释放我们自身的能源产能，例如让委内瑞拉摆脱马杜罗政权以恢复石油生产并增强美国的能源实力，再比如塑造一个让其他海湾国家能够摆脱现状、实现自主的世界格局。阿联酋已脱离旧的欧佩克配额体系，开始根据自身条件增产。伊拉克近期与美国企业达成协议修建输油管道，该管道将永久绕过霍尔木兹海峡。这正是贝桑特此前指出的50%至70%的转变，而这一转变正发生在短短两年的窗口期内。

paragraphs.en: Now, that doesn't even touch on the nuclear renaissance that this administration has unleashed. A big part of the empire's reliance on geopolitical choke points like the straight of Hormuse has been its suppression of nuclear power. Keeping the United States and other countries overly dependent on fossil fuels. Well, that anti-uclear insanity is over and the coming nuclear boom will vastly strengthen our energy independence.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，这甚至还没触及本届政府掀起的核能复兴浪潮。帝国之所以高度依赖霍尔木兹海峡等地缘政治咽喉，很大程度上正是源于对核能的打压，这使得美国及其他国家过度依赖化石燃料。如今，这种反核的疯狂已成过去，即将到来的核能热潮将极大增强我们的能源独立。

paragraphs.en: So, this is not a question of how many ships cross the straight of Hormuse today. This is a reassertion of the basic principles of economic sovereignty and of ensuring that your nation is not at the mercy of an imperial overlord which manipulates choke holes, controls insurance, and throttles your energy production. And this is how you look at what is happening from a strategic mountaintop and cut through the fog of war. That's what Prometheian Action does every day.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，这并非关乎今日有多少船只穿越霍尔木兹海峡的问题。这是在重申经济主权的基本原则，并确保你的国家不会受制于一个操纵咽喉要道、控制保险、扼制能源生产的帝国主义宗主国。从战略制高点俯瞰局势，拨开战争迷雾，正是看待当前事态的正确方式。而这正是“普罗米修斯行动”每天都在做的事。

paragraphs.en: And that's what you will see if you subscribe to our free newsletter. The link is in the description. So turning the straight of Hormoose into an irrelevancy is the tactical side of this. But underneath that tactic sits a system built 50 years ago.
paragraphs.zh: 如果您订阅我们的免费通讯，就能看到这些内容。链接在简介中。因此，使霍尔木兹海峡变得无关紧要，是这一策略的战术层面。但在这套战术背后，是一个建于五十年前的体系。

paragraphs.en: And that system was put on stage recently. Last month the British Empire's premier foreign policy outlet, Chattam House, convened a forum entitled The New Geopolitics of the Middle East. I don't think the hosts expected what happened. Recorded in front of a live audience.
paragraphs.zh: 而这一体系最近被推上了舞台。上个月，大英帝国首屈一指的外交政策智库——查塔姆研究所，举办了一场名为《中东新地缘政治》的论坛。我想主办方大概没料到会发生这样的局面。整个过程在观众面前进行了现场录制。

paragraphs.en: The political adviser to the president of Lebanon, Mr. Jean Aziz, delivered a series of stunning statements speaking for his country right there on the empire's own turf. He began by describing the new potential for his nation. For the first time, he said, in what is perhaps exactly 50 years, Lebanon presents a new situation. Then he named the names of the people who put Lebanon on that 50-year path of destruction, which is finally being reversed.
paragraphs.zh: 黎巴嫩总统政治顾问让·阿齐兹先生发表了一系列令人震撼的声明，代表本国在帝国本土直接发声。他首先阐述了本国面临的新潜力。他表示，或许是整整五十年来的首次，黎巴嫩正呈现出全新的局面。随后，他点名指出了那些将黎巴嫩推向长达五十年毁灭之路的责任人，而这条道路如今终于迎来了逆转。

paragraphs.en: Mr. Aziz described how Henry Kissinger sent his envoy, Dean Brown, to, as Mr. Aziz put it to manage the beginning of the war in Lebanon in 1976. Now listen carefully to this. >> Brown telephoned his secretary only for the letter to tell him forget about it. I found the solution. I will hand Lebanon to Hafisel Assad and the Israelis are in agreement.
paragraphs.zh: 阿齐兹先生描述了亨利·基辛格如何派遣其特使迪恩·布朗前往，正如阿齐兹先生所言，以“管控”1976年黎巴嫩战争的爆发。现在请仔细听这段内容。>> 布朗打电话给他的秘书，却只听到对方告诉他：“忘了这事吧。我已经找到解决方案了。我会把黎巴嫩交给哈菲兹·阿萨德，以色列方面也已同意。”

paragraphs.en: And of course the man was utterly mistaken in the wake of that episode. Lebanon lived through half a century since 1976 till now a half a century of wars, battles and instability which ended by entangling Syria, Israel, Europe, the states and above all the IRGC regime of Tan in a bloody quagmire. >> You really have to let that sink in. Mr. Raziz was there speaking on behalf of the Lebanese government, reading a prepared statement that publicly indicted Henry Kissinger for the destruction of Lebanon and other countries and for the emergence of the IRGC. And he did it at Chadam House, the place where Henry Kissinger himself admitted on the record in 1982 that he kept the British Foreign Office more closely informed than he kept the United States State Department.
paragraphs.zh: 当然，在那一事件之后，此人完全大错特错。自1976年至今，黎巴嫩经历了长达半个世纪的战争、冲突与动荡，最终将叙利亚、以色列、欧洲、美国，尤其是伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队政权，拖入了一场血腥的泥潭。>> 你们真的得好好想想这件事。拉齐兹先生当时代表黎巴嫩政府发言，宣读了一份事先准备好的声明，公开指控亨利·基辛格应对黎巴嫩及其他国家的毁灭以及伊斯兰革命卫队的崛起负责。而他发表这番言论的地点，正是查塔姆宫——正是在这里，基辛格本人在1982年曾公开承认，他向英国外交部通报的情况比向美国国务院通报的还要密切。

paragraphs.en: That's the indictment delivered out loud on their own stage in their own house. And in what world could a Lebanese official do that? A world in which the geopolitical grip of the empire is being broken by Donald Trump. Now, here's what's replacing it.
paragraphs.zh: 这是在他们的本土舞台上公开宣读的起诉书。究竟在怎样的世界里，黎巴嫩官员竟敢做出这种事？那是一个帝国的地缘政治控制正被唐纳德·特朗普打破的世界。那么，正在取代它的又是什么？

paragraphs.en: Mr. Aziz was not reading from a geopolitical handbook. He was describing the changing situation on the ground in Lebanon. First, Hezbollah's paymaster, namely the IRGC, has been degraded by both epic and economic fury. And as Mr. Rziz said, the Lebanese leadership no longer has to capitulate.
paragraphs.zh: 阿齐兹先生并非在照搬地缘政治教科书。他描述的是黎巴嫩实地不断演变的局势。首先，真主党的金主——即伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）——正遭受史诗般的与经济上的双重冲击而实力受损。正如阿齐兹先生所言，黎巴嫩领导层已不再需要屈服。

paragraphs.en: Second, he pointed to the change in Syria, which President Trump has cultivated. And finally he said there is >> a fundamental international change embodied in western and particularly American attention to Lebanon on attention at once serious and practical and one congruent with our reading of the true nature of the crisis and the feasible solutions >> particularly the Americans as in Donald Trump's America which is no longer were operating off of the empire's Kissinger implemented policy. Now, at that same Chattam House conference, the official fromQatar, Majed Alanssari, dropped another bombshell on the hosts. He made clear that the Gulf states have torn up the playbook as well and are acting in their own interests as opposed to what he called extra regional forces.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，他指出叙利亚局势发生了变化，而这一变化正是特朗普总统所推动的。最后，他指出，出现了一种根本性的国际格局变化，这体现在西方——尤其是美国——对黎巴嫩局势的关注上。这种关注既严肃又务实，与我们对危机本质及可行解决方案的判断完全一致。尤其是美国，在唐纳德·特朗普领导下的美国，已不再沿用昔日帝国时代由基辛格推行的政策。与此同时，在同一场查塔姆宫研究所的会议上，卡塔尔官员马吉德·安萨里向与会者抛出了另一枚“重磅炸弹”。他明确表示，海湾国家也已撕毁了旧有的行事准则，转而根据自身利益采取行动，而非听从他所称的“域外势力”摆布。

paragraphs.en: And he did it by describing how the Gaza 20oint peace plan came about. is a good example of this. How did we get to the 20 point plan? We got to the 20oint plan because eight countries from the Arab and Muslim world came together, went to President Trump with a clear plan, put their weight behind it, went to Cairo, went to Shahashik, signed the deal, and are still continuing to work on a resolution. It was not delusional.
paragraphs.zh: 他正是通过阐述加沙二十点和平计划的由来来说明这一点。这正是一个很好的例证。我们是如何达成二十点计划的？之所以能达成该计划，是因为八个阿拉伯和伊斯兰国家联合起来，带着明确的方案面见特朗普总统，鼎力支持该计划，先后前往开罗和沙姆沙伊赫签署协议，并仍在继续努力推动相关解决方案。这绝非不切实际。

paragraphs.en: It was not ambitious. It was very practical. And right now, while we are looking at a very severe humanitarian crisis in in Raza, we are still pushing for a practical possible solution to the humanitarian crisis over there. We are looking through the the lens of countries in the region rather than just waiting for somebody extra regionally to come in and solve our crisis for us. >> That regional deal that he describes, the October plan signed at Charbell Shake is what became the board of peace. seated in Washington for its first meeting on February 19th, 2026. > 他所描述的这项区域协议，即10月在沙姆沙伊赫签署的计划，最终演变成了和平委员会。该委员会于2026年2月19日在华盛顿召开首次会议。
paragraphs.zh: 这并非什么宏大的构想，而是十分务实的。眼下，尽管我们正目睹加沙地带极为严重的人道主义危机，但我们仍在推动一项切实可行的方案来解决那里的危机。我们是从区域国家的视角出发来审视此事，而不是坐等区域外的某方介入替我们解决危机。

paragraphs.en: And who did Donald Trump take a jab at during the founding meeting? >> And I said, "Steve, how would you like to be Henry Kissinger Jr. that doesn't leak?" They said, "Are you a leaker, Steve?" No. He didn't even know what the word meant. And it's true. I always say Henry Kissinger, who was one of the great leakers of all time, by the way. Richard Nixon said to him, "Henry, Henry, who's leaking all this stuff?" I don't know, Mr. President. and it was Henry. >> A typical apparently off-hand side comment by Donald Trump. > 我说：“史蒂夫，你想不想当个不泄密的小亨利·基辛格？” > 这显然是唐纳德·特朗普典型的随口调侃。
paragraphs.zh:
在成立会议上，唐纳德·特朗普暗讽了谁？
他们问：“史蒂夫，你是泄密者吗？”不是。他连这个词的意思都不知道。这倒是真的。我常说，亨利·基辛格可是历史上最顶级的泄密者之一，顺便提一句。尼克松曾对他说：“亨利啊亨利，这些消息都是谁泄露的？”基辛格答道：“我不知道，总统先生。”但实际上就是基辛格自己干的。

paragraphs.en: But given what Mr. Aziz said about Henry Kissinger at Chadam House, do you think the Lebanese took it as a side comment? Do you think any official whose country and people have been ruined by perpetual war took it as a side comment? No. Donald Trump was telling anyone who listened that the board of peace and the people involved in it represent the opposite of the Kissinger model. Kissinger system treated nations like pieces on a board.
paragraphs.zh: 但是，鉴于阿齐兹先生在查塔姆研究所关于亨利·基辛格的言论，你认为黎巴嫩人会将此视为一句附带评论吗？你认为任何一个国家与人民因无休止的战争而遭受重创的官员，会把它当作随口一提的评论吗？不会。唐纳德·特朗普是在向所有倾听者表明：和平委员会及其相关人员代表的是基辛格模式的反面。基辛格体系将国家视为棋盘上的棋子。

paragraphs.en: Moved around, sacrificed whatever kept the balance of power intact for the men doing the moving. The Board of Peace and the Abraham Accords treat nations like builders, countries with a stake in their own prosperity and not chips in somebody else's game. That indictment at Chattam House wasn't an accident. It represents a new configuration of nations in the Middle East, telling the former game masters that their great game has been shut down and it's been shut down by Donald Trump.
paragraphs.zh: 局势被随意摆布，维持权力平衡的一切被牺牲，只为服务那些操盘者的利益。《亚伯拉罕协议》与和平委员会将各国视为建设者，是那些与自身繁荣息息相关的国家，而非他人棋盘上的棋子。查塔姆研究所的那份批判并非偶然。它标志着中东国家格局的新重组，向昔日的游戏主宰者宣告：他们的那场“大博弈”已彻底终结，而终结这一切的，正是唐纳德·特朗普。

paragraphs.en: Mr. Aziz didn't describe a policy mistake. He laid out how one man's phone call in 1976 produced 50 years of destruction. And the system that that destruction served is now being dismantled. Bessant is cutting the money.

paragraphs.en: Chris Wright is rrooting the energy. The Gulf States are building their own security instead of waiting for permission. And Lebanon just said the quiet part out loud from a stage in London for anybody paying attention. The system is being dismantled.
paragraphs.zh: 克里斯·赖特正在重塑能源格局。海湾国家正着手构建自身的安全体系，不再坐等他人许可。黎巴嫩刚刚在伦敦的舞台上把大家心照不宣的话挑明了，任何关注此事的人都能听清。旧体系正在被瓦解。

paragraphs.en: Now, I'm going to close on a personal note. Today is August 15th, 2026. 55 years ago, Richard Nixon took the dollar off the gold reserve standard and ended the Brettonwood system. That is the day I joined a political movement which understood way back then what that meant. That America's sovereignty was under attack.

paragraphs.zh: 我看过不少。但他说，你知道，我们该如何解决这样一个问题：确实需要私有财产，也确实必须保护私有财产；但财富过度集中对社会有害，我们又该如何应对这一事实呢？该怎么处理这个问题？

paragraphs.en: Well, the nice answer to that is our founding fathers figured that out 250 years ago. It's called the American system of political economy, which is not just this simple binary thing. It forces you to think through. How do you make a decision in terms of where investment in your country goes?
paragraphs.zh: 其实，一个很好的答案是，我们的建国先贤在250年前就已经想明白了。这被称为“美国政治经济体系”，它并非简单的二元对立。它促使你深入思考：在决定国家投资流向时，该如何做出抉择？

paragraphs.en: How do you What What is the metric by which your society is going to prosper and survive in the future? Is it just the accumulation of money? I mean, that's a real simple, easy, you know, num- num-nut method. I just want to make a lot of money, and that's my metric.
paragraphs.zh: 衡量一个社会未来能否繁荣与存续的标准是什么？难道仅仅是金钱的积累吗？我的意思是，那标准也太简单粗暴了。我只是想赚大钱，这就是我的衡量标准。

paragraphs.en: You know, I get to make whatever profit I want. Or is there something a little bit more challenging in terms of thinking how society is actually grow? How do people become more productive? How do they invent new discoveries?
paragraphs.zh: 你知道，我想赚多少利润都可以。又或者，在思考社会实际如何增长这件事上，是否存在更具挑战性的视角？人们如何提高生产力？又是怎样取得新的突破与发现的？

paragraphs.en: How do those new discoveries get back out into the population and proliferate throughout a a vibrant entrepreneurial class? How do you solve that paradox of yes, there has to be private property, but there has to be another metric in this entire mix? And that's that's what we try and do in our discussions, which is to get people out of the binaries and into a process where they're actually thinking through, how does the universe really work? And I guarantee you it is not on the basis of Adam Smith's invisible hand.
paragraphs.zh: 这些新发现如何重新传播至大众，并在充满活力的企业家阶层中广泛扩散？我们该如何化解这样一个悖论：是的，私有财产确实不可或缺，但在这个整体框架中，难道不应还有另一个衡量标准吗？而这正是我们在讨论中试图达成的目标——引导人们跳出非此即彼的二元对立思维，进入一个让他们真正深入思考“世界究竟是如何运作的”的过程。我敢保证，它绝不是建立在亚当·斯密那只“看不见的手”的基础之上的。

paragraphs.en: That is not how this works. >> and and it is um how they have the city of London through its proxies has deliberately omitted the American system of political economy from political discourse and from history. It's been erased. Not the only thing that's been erased. I I want to go back to data centers.
paragraphs.zh: 事情可不是这么运作的。>> 而且，伦敦金融城通过其代理人，刻意将美国政治经济体系从政治话语和历史中抹去。它已经被彻底清除。被抹去的远不止这一项。我想回到数据中心的话题上。

paragraphs.en: Obviously, the question of artificial intelligence, which is a terrible word because there is no such thing as artificial intelligence. paragraphs.en: And one of the scary things about it is is the idea that human beings can be replaced by computers. We can't. I guarantee you. If if the if the AIs start talking to each other and taking over and wipe out the human race, they're going to end up wiping themselves out because they cannot they cannot make creative breakthroughs to move society forward. articles.title: UNTOUCHABLE: The Machine Behind Fauci the Senate Hearing Won't Expose

paragraphs.en: Today, Tony Fouchy sits before the US Senate facing a grilling by senators who can prove that he lied to them and lied over and over again to the American people. He lied about CO's origins and the necessity for closures and mandates. And he joined with the media, the intelligence community, and major scientific institutions to destroy any scientist attempting to stop him. He is taking the fifth despite his pardon by Joe Biden.
paragraphs.zh: 今天，托尼·富奇坐在美国参议院面前，面临参议员们的严厉质询。这些参议员能够证明他不仅向他们撒谎，还一次又一次地向美国民众撒谎。他在CO疫情的起源以及实施封锁和强制令的必要性上撒了谎。他还与媒体、情报界以及主要科研机构联手，摧毁任何试图阻止他的科学家。尽管乔·拜登已赦免他，他仍援引第五修正案保持沉默。

paragraphs.en: His bet is that his media friends, the Democrats, and rigged DC courts will save him. But even in the ensuing legal controversy to come, the one question that actually matters will probably not be asked. How did he get away with it until now? How do we prevent the next Tony Fouchy claiming to be an expert from a repeat performance?
paragraphs.zh: 他指望媒体盟友、民主党人以及被操纵的华盛顿特区法院能救他。但即便随之而来的法律争议爆发，真正关键的问题恐怕也无人会问。他至今为何能逍遥法外？我们该如何防止下一个自称专家的托尼·富奇故技重施？

paragraphs.en: Today we'll answer that, but the answer won't come from today's hearing. It came from the White House a week ago. I'm Barbara Boyd, and I've studied how the British intelligence services invented and maintained the media propaganda regime, which manufactures popular consent ever since World War I. Today, I'll discuss what the congressional investigation has produced and why it's not enough. We'll outline the consensus building machinery which made Fouchy untouchable until now.
paragraphs.zh: 今天我们将对此作出回答，但答案并非来自今天的听证会，而是早在上周白宫就已给出。我是芭芭拉·博伊德。自第一次世界大战以来，英国情报机构便创立并维系着一套媒体宣传机制，用以制造公众共识，而我一直深入研究其运作方式。今天，我将探讨国会调查取得了哪些成果，以及为何这些成果仍显不足。我们还将梳理那套构建共识的运作机制，正是它让福奇至今得以免受追究。

paragraphs.en: Then we'll show you the White House answer and how it changes everything. But before I dig in, hit that like button and share this video. It's a significant one and we want to make sure it gets maximum reach on YouTube. Now, Fouch's recently released diary unearthed by Robert F. Kennedy Jr. because he kept it on government servers reveals him to be a psychotic narcissist.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们将展示白宫的回应，以及它如何彻底改变一切。但在深入探讨之前，请点击点赞按钮并分享本视频。这是一期非常重要的内容，我们希望确保它在 YouTube 上获得最大范围的传播。现在，罗伯特·F·肯尼迪 Jr. 最近发布了一本日记。这本日记之所以能被挖掘出来，是因为它被保存在政府服务器上，而日记内容揭示了福奇是一个精神病态的自恋者。

paragraphs.en: It also shows that he lied about CO publicly while writing his actual and very different thoughts in [clears throat] his diary. He rebelled in being a celebrity, calling himself science incarnate while millions died as the result of his cover up of CO's origins and its true nature. The liberal media either not covering the story or they're attempting to distort it. That's because they are complicit in it.
paragraphs.zh: 这也表明，他公开场合对CO撒谎，却在[清嗓子]日记中写下了自己真实且截然不同的想法。他借名人身份公然反抗，自诩为“科学的化身”，而数百万人却因他掩盖CO的起源及其真实面目而丧生。自由派媒体要么对此事避而不报，要么试图歪曲事实。这正是因为他们与此事同流合污。

paragraphs.en: They went along with one of the most monstrous crimes of our lifetimes. It sweep included the rigged election which yielded an incompetent man as president of the United States. Here's Larry Oconor on Mark Hpurn's two-way broadcast Tuesday. >> I'd like a venture guest to your question about why liberals love him and why the left and the media love him. It has to do with Trump. > 我想邀请一位嘉宾来回答你的问题：为什么自由派喜欢他？为什么左翼和媒体也都喜欢他？这与特朗普有关。
paragraphs.zh: 他们默许了我们有生以来最骇人听闻的罪行之一。其中包括那场被操纵的选举，正是这场选举让一个无能之辈当上了美国总统。以下是拉里·奥康纳在马克·赫恩周二的双向广播节目中的片段：

paragraphs.en: I I'm sorry, but the Trump was going to win re-election. CO 19 did not hurt him. The lockdown hurt him. Shutting down our economy, shutting down our schools, and making people's lives miserable and demonizing any governor like Christine Gnome or Greg Abbott or Ronda Santis who started questioning the advice from Fouchy and the federal government.
paragraphs.zh: 很抱歉，但特朗普本来就会赢得连任。新冠疫情并没有拖累他。真正拖累他的是封锁令。封锁令导致我们的经济停摆、学校关闭，让民众生活陷入困境，还让那些开始质疑福奇和联邦政府建议的州长（如克里斯汀·格诺姆、格雷格·阿博特或罗恩·德桑蒂斯）遭到妖魔化。

paragraphs.en: They were demonized. All of that fed into the chaos of 2020 that led to the election and led to Donald Trump not winning a second term and and they love him for that. The hearing will outline much further evidence of Fouch's criminality, but it won't adequately expose or change the system of which Fouchy is a symptom. Why did every major scientific institution NIH, CDC, the Lancet, Nature say the same thing at the same time?
paragraphs.zh: 他们被妖魔化了。这一切都加剧了2020年的混乱局面，进而影响了大选，导致唐纳德·特朗普未能连任，而他们因此对他心怀感激。听证会将进一步列举福奇的更多犯罪证据，但无法充分揭露或改变这一体制，而福奇只是该体制的“症状”。为什么每家主要的科学机构——美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）、美国疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）、《柳叶刀》、《自然》——都在同一时间说出完全相同的话？

paragraphs.en: Why was every dissenting voice, the great Bington scientists, lab league journalists, MRNA skeptics systematically destroyed? This is not science. This is consensus enforcement. And that consensus enforcement wasn't just killing CO victims until Donald Trump.
paragraphs.zh: 为什么每一个持异议的声音，包括那些著名的宾顿科学家、实验室泄漏理论的记者以及mRNA怀疑论者，都遭到系统性地抹杀？这根本不是科学，而是强制共识。而这种强制共识的做法不仅导致了新冠患者的死亡，而且一直延续至唐纳德·特朗普执政时期。

paragraphs.en: It was destroying the future of our nation. We're going to be talking about this much more in our free newsletter at Prometheianaction.com. Sign up. The link is in the description.
paragraphs.zh: 它正在摧毁我们国家的未来。我们将在 Prometheianaction.com 的免费通讯中更多地探讨这一话题。请立即注册。链接在简介中。

paragraphs.en: Now, CO wasn't the first time Fouchy or manufacturer scientific consensus killed whole swast of our population. During the AIDS epidemic, Fouchy promoted a toxic drug while suppressing useful therapeutics. Robert F. Kennedy Jr. documents this in his book, The Real Anthony Fouchy. The opioid epidemic is a similar story, although not linked to Fouchi directly.
paragraphs.zh: 如今，新冠疫情并非福奇或人为炮制的“科学共识”首次导致大批民众丧生。在艾滋病疫情期间，福奇曾推广一种有毒药物，同时打压有效的治疗方法。小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪在其著作《真正的安东尼·福奇》中详细记录了这一点。阿片类药物危机也是类似的故事，尽管这与福奇没有直接关联。

paragraphs.en: Purdue Pharma got expert medical journals to lie that Oxycontton is nonaddictive. The climate hoax engineered by compromised scientific experts and financial globalists convinced many in a generation having children was an irrational and irresponsible act. Real science has never been about expert consensus. It's been about adversarial testing.
paragraphs.zh: 普渡制药曾操纵专家医学期刊，谎称奥施康定不具成瘾性。由被利益裹挟的科学专家与金融全球主义者炮制的气候骗局，让这一代中的许多人相信，生育子女是一种非理性且不负责任的行为。真正的科学从来不是关于专家共识，而是在于对抗性检验。

paragraphs.en: Where the maverick isn't the nuisance, he's the method. That's how it worked when Kepler proved the orbits of the planets were elliptical, not circular. And when a young Einstein appended Newton from a patent office, that's how Elon Musk changed the entire way NASA thinks about rockets. But that adversarial engine breaks down when funding concentrates in a handful of hands.
paragraphs.zh: 特立独行者并非麻烦，而是方法本身。开普勒证明行星轨道是椭圆而非圆形时，正是如此；年轻的爱因斯坦在专利局工作时超越牛顿，埃隆·马斯克彻底改变NASA对火箭的思维方式，也都是通过这种方式。然而，当资金集中在少数人手中时，这种对抗性机制便会失效。

paragraphs.en: Scientists don't bite the hands that funds their lab, their postocs, their next grand cycle. And nothing exposed that faster than February 2020 when the Lancet published a letter from 27 scientists declaring with zero disscent, zero debate that the lab leak hypothesis was quote a conspiracy theory. The letter wasn't a spontaneous outpouring of scientific consensus at all. It was drafted and organized by Peter Dazac, president of Echo Health Alliance, the very organization funneling NIH grant money into the Wuhan Institute of Biologies Corona Research.
paragraphs.zh: 科学家绝不会去咬那只资助他们实验室、博士后研究人员以及下一个重大资助周期的手。而最能迅速揭穿这一点的，莫过于2020年2月《柳叶刀》杂志发表的一封由27位科学家联署的信件。信中毫无异议、未加讨论便断言，实验室泄漏假说纯属“阴谋论”。这封信绝非科学界自发形成的共识表达。该信件由生态健康联盟主席彼得·达扎克起草并牵头组织，而该机构正是将美国国立卫生研究院的拨款资金源源不断输送给武汉病毒研究所冠状病毒研究项目的组织。

paragraphs.en: Dazak orchestrated his letter to look like scientific consensus by leaving his role out of it deliberately. Walther Litman an American member of the British roundt published a book called public opinion in 1922. It said the modern world has grown too complex with ordinary citizens unable to grasp reality directly. People he said act on simplified quote pictures in their heads rather than reality itself.
paragraphs.zh: 达扎克精心策划了这封信，故意隐去自己的角色，使其看起来像是科学界的共识。沃尔特·李普曼（英国圆桌会议的美国成员）于1922年出版了《公众舆论》一书。书中指出，现代世界已变得过于复杂，普通公民已无法直接把握现实。他表示，人们并非依据现实本身行事，而是依据头脑中简化的心理图景行事。

paragraphs.en: To fix this, he said, we need specialized expert staffed intelligence bureaus positioned between the public and decision makers. They gather and interpret information and manage what the public understands. As Ritman put it, they quote manufacture consent. That's the role our media and our intelligence services have played ever since.
paragraphs.zh: 他表示，要解决这个问题，我们需要由专家组成的专门情报机构，置于公众与决策者之间。这些机构负责收集并解读信息，并引导公众的认知。正如里特曼所言，它们“制造共识”。这正是我们的媒体和情报机构自此以来所扮演的角色。

paragraphs.en: That's what you see in the lies about COVID and in the censorship on social media platforms after pressure from the FBI and CIA on both CO and the Hunter Biden laptop. It's a welloiled machine now which not only manufactures consent, it attempts to enforce it. If you watch the buildup to Lindsey Graham's funeral this week, it was fully in action. Thinking they could milk the president's grief about Graham's death, Netanyahu and Zuinsky each created a fake intelligence piece amplified mightily by the media to honor Lindsey Graham's war hawk madness.
paragraphs.zh: 这正是你在新冠疫情的谎言以及社交媒体平台上的审查中所看到的——尤其是在FBI和CIA对CO及亨特·拜登笔记本电脑事件施压之后。如今，这已是一台运转精密的机器，它不仅制造“共识”，还试图强行推行。如果你观察本周林赛·格雷厄姆葬礼前的舆论造势，就能发现它正在全力运转。他们妄图利用总统对格雷厄姆逝世的悲痛大做文章，内塔尼亚胡与祖因斯基各自炮制了一份虚假情报，并经媒体大肆渲染，以此“致敬”林赛·格雷厄姆那好战鹰派的疯狂行径。

paragraphs.en: The continued media course about lack of US supplies and the unpopularity of the war here encouraged factions of the IRGC and suicide attacks on US bases yesterday. While Netanyahu and Zillinsky were making their pitches, Saudi Arabia and SECOM responded. From Ukraine, Zinsky claimed Russia was helping the Ukrainians target American bases. from Israel. Netanyahu had a piece claiming Iran was rebuilding its nuclear capacity.
paragraphs.zh: 持续的媒体报道聚焦于美国物资短缺及战争在此地不得人心，这促使伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）的部分派系及针对美军基地的自杀式袭击于昨日发生。在内塔尼亚胡与泽连斯基进行游说之际，沙特阿拉伯与SECOM作出了回应。泽连斯基从乌克兰方面声称，俄罗斯正协助乌军瞄准美军基地；内塔尼亚胡则从以色列方面发表声明称，伊朗正在重建其核能力。

paragraphs.en: The difference between Trump and past presidents who succumbed to this machine is that Trump is a builder and defines himself as a maverick. He answered both Netanyahu and Zolinsky in an interview with Fox and Friends on Tuesday. Here are the key clips. >> Very interesting with Lindsay. He was very much a hawk, as you would say, on a run. > 与林赛的互动非常有趣。用你们的话说，他当时可是个十足的鹰派，而且势头正猛。
paragraphs.zh: 特朗普与那些向这台机器屈服的历届总统不同，他是一位建设者，并且自视为特立独行的人。在周二接受福克斯《朋友早间秀》节目采访时，他分别回应了内塔尼亚胡和佐林斯基。以下是关键片段。

paragraphs.en: And over the last few weeks, I would say that he became like, if you could make a deal, it's better that better making a deal in this case than just uh destroying the rest of the country. We've destroyed most of it, frankly. But uh he was he was somebody that said it's a good time to make a deal. Nice time to make a deal. >> What does a good deal look like? >> Now, I wouldn't say necessarily he feels that way about Ukraine. > 什么样的协议才算好协议？ > 不过，我不一定认为他对乌克兰也有同样的看法。
paragraphs.zh: 过去几周里，我觉得他的态度有所转变。如果可以达成协议，在他看来，在这种情况下达成协议总比把国家其余部分彻底毁掉要好。坦白说，我们其实已经把大部分给毁了。但他确实说过，现在是达成协议的好时机，是个不错的时机。

paragraphs.en: Ukraine he's very uh militant about. I mean, Lindsay liked war to be honest with you, okay? You know, I said, "You're a nice guy. How come you like war so much?" He was a guy that liked war.
paragraphs.zh: 关于乌克兰，他态度非常强硬。说实话，林赛这家伙其实挺喜欢战争的，你懂的。你知道的，我当时还问他：“你人挺好的，怎么这么喜欢打仗呢？”他确实就是个喜欢战争的人。

paragraphs.en: I jokingly say, and it's nothing funny about it, but he's never seen a war that he didn't like. >> There are reports now that um Netanyahu is going to talk to you about ongoing excavation at um Pickax Mountain, construction vehicles entering and exiting t exiting tunnels, paving new access roads. Satellite imagery and intel indicates that Iran is actively constructing and fortifying Pickax Mountain. How will we respond? >> Well, I don't need BB to tell me that. BB's telling me that because he wants me to stay involved. > 目前有报道称，内塔尼亚胡将与你会谈，讨论镐山地区正在进行的挖掘工程，包括施工车辆进出隧道以及铺设新通道等事宜。卫星图像与情报显示，伊朗正积极对镐山进行建设与加固。我们将作何回应？ > 嗯，其实不必BB特意提醒我。他之所以告诉我这些，是希望我能继续参与其中。
paragraphs.zh: 我开玩笑地说，但这其实一点也不好笑——他似乎从未见过一场他不喜欢的战争。

paragraphs.en: I mean, I don't necessarily. We have the finest because of Space Force. We have the greatest cameras in the world focused on We know exactly what's going on, >> but no, I heard BB announce that. I said, why don't you just tell it to me?
paragraphs.zh: 我的意思是，我不一定同意。多亏了太空军，我们才拥有最顶尖的系统。我们配备了全球最强大的摄像头，镜头对准……我们完全清楚到底发生了什么。但并不是，我是从BB那里听到这则消息的。我当时就想，你干嘛不直接告诉我呢？

paragraphs.en: Why do you have to announce it to the world? I know exactly what's going on at Pickax. It's not a big problem. We took out their nuclear sites and we'll have to take out pickaxe if we don't make a deal. >> Despite their differences, Donald Trump made Lindsey Graham his friend and sought to change him.
paragraphs.zh: “你为什么要向全世界宣布？我对伊朗的实际情况一清二楚。这根本不是大问题。我们已经摧毁了他们的核设施，如果谈不成协议，我们就得再次打击伊朗。” >> 尽管两人存在分歧，唐纳德·特朗普还是将林赛·格雷厄姆变成了自己的朋友，并试图改变他。

paragraphs.en: Both the fakers, Zilinsky and Netanyahu, will be leaving Washington with instructions from the president to seek peace. You can bet the complicit press will try to frame it differently. Now, on July 21st, Michael Katzios, the president's science adviser, introduced a proposal to redirect all federal science funding toward the mavericks. Underlying it is the principle repeatedly cited by Elon Musk.
paragraphs.zh: 这两位造假者齐林斯基和内塔尼亚胡将带着总统寻求和平的指示离开华盛顿。你完全可以断定，那些包庇的媒体会试图以不同的方式来包装此事。7月21日，总统科学顾问迈克尔·卡齐奥斯提出了一项提案，拟将所有联邦科学资金重新定向给那些“特立独行者”。其背后的原则正是埃隆·马斯克反复引用的。

paragraphs.en: Physics doesn't lie. Producing something that works requires finding and obeying nature's laws and constant testing and proofs of principle. Here is how Quatiosa's proposal starts. Though our investments in research have grown, scientific productivity has slowed.
paragraphs.zh: 物理学不会说谎。要想做出真正管用的东西，就必须发现并遵循自然规律，同时不断进行测试与原理验证。夸蒂奥萨的提案是这样开头的：尽管我们在科研上的投入持续增长，但科学生产力却有所放缓。

paragraphs.en: We have become dependent on a narrow set of legacy institutions. Our incentive structures, get this, reward conformity over bold inquiry. And the capacity that once turned American discoveries into American strength has eroded, undermined by decades of industrial offshoring. It goes on to attack the expert scientific bureaucracy.
paragraphs.zh: 我们已变得过度依赖少数几家传统机构。我们的激励机制，要知道，奖励的是循规蹈矩，而非大胆探究。而曾经将美国科研成果转化为国家实力的能力已然衰退，数十年的产业外迁更是不断削弱了这一根基。它接着抨击了专家科学官僚体系。

paragraphs.en: The US research system should prioritize the individual scientist over legacy institutions. If we are serious about expanding what our scientists can do, we must invest directly in American researchers and the bold ideas that drive them. Too much of our research expertise has come to serve itself rather than the scientists within it. Federal funding agencies should support a broader range of performers, including a new generation of missiondriven research organizations to expand our scientific horizons. and these agencies should organize themselves around the interdisciplinary frontiers of science today rather than the academic silos of the last century.
paragraphs.zh: 美国的科研体系应当优先考虑个体科学家，而非传统机构。若我们真心想拓展科学家的研究能力，就必须直接资助美国科研人员，并大力支持驱动他们的大胆构想。如今，过多的科研实力与专业能力反而在自我服务，而非真正服务于其中的科研人员。联邦资助机构应当支持更多元化的科研主体，包括新一代以使命为导向的研究机构，以拓展我们的科学视野。同时，这些机构应当围绕当今科学的跨学科前沿来重构自身架构，而非沿用上世纪的学科壁垒。

paragraphs.en: The report compares the relative lack of new inventions and discoveries under previous administrations with the way they treated trade. For decades, American free trade policy assumed that if we just kept markets open, good things would follow automatically based on increased efficiency. Instead, other countries protected their own industries while exploiting ours and we lost our manufacturing base. Now, directed interventions through tariffs is rebuilding that base.
paragraphs.zh: 该报告将前任政府时期新发明与发现相对匮乏的状况，与其在贸易问题上的做法进行了对比。数十年来，美国自由贸易政策一直假定，只要保持市场开放，效率提升带来的好处便会自动随之而来。然而现实却是，其他国家在保护本国产业的同时却利用我们的产业，导致我们丧失了制造业根基。如今，通过关税实施定向干预，正在重建这一制造业基础。

paragraphs.en: The Katius report applies the same logic to developing fusion energy and other frontier technologies. America invented most of the physics behind fusion energy, the plasma science, the materials, the reactor concepts. But inventing the science and actually building the industry are two very different things. America has a habit now of doing the first and losing the second.
paragraphs.zh: 《Katius报告》将同样的逻辑应用于发展聚变能源和其他前沿技术。美国发明了聚变能源背后的绝大多数物理学原理、等离子体科学、相关材料以及反应堆概念。但科学发明与实际构建产业是截然不同的两回事。美国如今的习惯是：擅长前者，却失去后者。

paragraphs.en: We invented flat panel displays. Asia builds them now. We embedded the best lithium ion battery chemistry. Asian factories dominate that supply chain too.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发明了平板显示屏。如今由亚洲生产。我们研发了最先进的锂离子电池技术。亚洲工厂也主导着那条供应链。

paragraphs.en: The fear driving this report is that fusion and the other frontiers of technologies of the future could go the exact same way and will be left far far behind. Now our advancing science has to be wed at every stage to advanced manufacturing platforms right here in the United States. The report attacks DEI hiring in science fields and the posity of physics and engineering graduates here. This suicidal practice must end.
paragraphs.zh: 驱动这份报告的核心担忧是，核聚变及其他未来技术的前沿领域可能会走上完全相同的路径，从而被远远甩在后面。如今，我们不断发展的科学必须与美国本土的先进制造平台在每个环节都紧密结合。该报告抨击了科学领域的多元化、公平与包容（DEI）招聘政策，以及物理与工程领域毕业生严重短缺的问题。这种自杀式的做法必须终止。

paragraphs.en: It must be replaced by programs which reward merit, accomplishment, and a focus on the physical sciences and engineering. Risk-taking and contrarian thinking are target priorities now for funding as well as funding scientists specifically to verify results. All of the federal government science agencies are mandated now to incorporate this new funding strategy into their 2027 2028 budgets by September of this year. So how did Fouchi get away with it?
paragraphs.zh: 必须用奖励功绩与成就、并侧重物理科学与工程学的项目来取代它。如今，资助的重点目标已明确转向鼓励冒险精神与逆向思维，同时专门拨款支持科学家对研究结果进行验证。联邦政府各科学机构现被强制要求，必须于今年9月前将这一新的资助策略纳入2027至2028财年预算。那么，福奇究竟是如何逃脱问责的？

paragraphs.en: His crimes were not that exceptional in a corrupt consensus driven scientific culture. The consensus was supported by a media propaganda machine which has ceased to investigate or publish inconvenient truths and an intelligence community at war with this president. Obedience to expert opinion replace pursuit of the truth. Donald Trump is now engaged in dismantling both parts of the consensus machine.
paragraphs.zh: 在一个腐败的、以共识为导向的科学文化中，他的罪行并不算特别突出。这种共识由一个媒体宣传机器所支撑，该机器已不再调查或发布不利真相，以及一个正与这位总统为敌的情报界。对专家意见的服从取代了对真相的追求。唐纳德·特朗普如今正致力于拆解这台共识机器的这两个部分。

paragraphs.en: Today's hearing will fully expose, but I predict it won't be able to answer the question, how in the world did this happen? By attacking the intelligence community and the scientific consensus establishment, Trump and Kratzios are destroying the world which allowed Fouchi to claim expertise and almost destroy this nation. If you talk to people about our videos, you know there's a lack of understanding out there about the very real revolution the president and his cabinet have undertaken. This report is a part of it.
paragraphs.zh: 今天的听证会将全面揭露真相，但我预测它仍无法回答那个核心问题：这究竟是怎么发生的？特朗普和克拉齐奥斯通过抨击情报界与科学共识建制派，正在摧毁那个曾让福奇得以标榜专业权威、并险些将国家推向毁灭的旧有体系。如果你就我们的视频与公众交流，就会发现大众对我们总统及其内阁所推动的这场切实变革仍缺乏充分认知。本报告正是这一进程的重要组成部分。

paragraphs.en: Prometheian Action is trying to cure that ahead of the midterms. But to do that effectively, we need to grow. You can help us do that by becoming paid subscriber to our newsletter or contributing as much as you can. This has been your Wednesday brief.

articles.title: Donald Trump Wields Secret Weapon Against London and Iran

paragraphs.en: These are families that have dealt with this and they've never gotten a single dime. These families have never gotten restitution and not a single president has ever stood up to them. Love Donald Trump or hate him. Love his policies, hate ICE, love ICE, whatever.

paragraphs.en: There's never been a single president who has stood up to Iran and hit back. >> That death cult description fits the disease globalist culture centered in the city of London in which the IRGC has functioned as a deployable terrorism asset for 47 years. That larger cult uses naroterrorism and Iran's religious terrorism as a weapon of war worldwide. It's just as deadly cultural attacks on scientific and technological progress through environmentalism kill more slowly. I'm Barbara Boyd.
paragraphs.zh: 从未有过一位总统敢于正面抗衡伊朗并予以反击。>> 这种“死亡邪教”的定性，恰恰契合了以伦敦为中心的病态全球主义文化。在这套体系中，伊斯兰革命卫队已作为可随时部署的恐怖主义资产运作了47年。这个更大的邪教将毒品恐怖主义与伊朗的宗教恐怖主义作为全球战争武器。而通过环保主义对科技进步发起的文化攻击同样致命，只是夺去生命的过程更为缓慢。我是芭芭拉·博伊德。

paragraphs.en: I follow the attempt to impose a postindustrial new dark age on the United States ever since Paul Erlick published the population bomb in 1968. That was also when the drug saturated counterculture and the new left began their present attack on the United States. The Iranian Revolution and the end of nuclear power at 3M Island, both in 1979, are chapters in the very same book. Today, I'll show you the biggest stories of the past week.
paragraphs.zh: 自1968年保罗·埃利希出版《人口炸弹》以来，我一直在关注这一企图：将美国强行推入后工业时代的新黑暗时期。那也是被毒品浸透的反文化运动与新左派开始对美国发动当前攻势的起点。1979年的伊朗革命与三哩岛核电厂的停运，都是同一本书中的篇章。今天，我将为您梳理过去一周的重大新闻。
